answer: Ephemeral answer challenge. Each identity must answer a fresh, randomly generated puzzle whose seed is tied to a whisper of local entropy and expires in seconds. An attacker cannot precompute or reuse responses: every clone needs a live solver session, and each session consumes a unique pigment-marked nonce that cannot be transferred. The zephyr of time pressure forces real-time computation per identity, so mass cloning costs one full solving cycle per clone plus coordination latency, making sybil scaling linear and observable.
